Thanks again for taking the demo today — great conversation. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can move procurement forward: 

Recap (2 minute):
- Pilot scope: 30-day evaluation, 3 seats, production-like traffic for a single workload (customer support summarization pipeline).
- Success criteria: <10% latency regression versus baseline; cost target <$0.006/token for inference.

Key commercial/procurement items we need to confirm:
1) Preferred payment route: PO (standard for enterprise) vs corporate card for pilot. Any AP thresholds we should plan around?
2) Marketplace interest: you mentioned your procurement team prefers vendor in marketplace if available — would that shortcut vendor onboarding?
3) Vendor onboarding: we will share a short vendor_form + standard SOW for legal/finance review. Who is the correct procurement contact to receive the onboarding packet?

Proposed immediate next steps:
- I will attach a draft SOW and the vendor_onboarding_form.xlsx for your intake team (attached).
- Neha (cc'd) can scope any SOW edits for the pilot and confirm pricing tiers.
- If a card pilot is acceptable for low-dollar POCs, we can start immediately; otherwise we can prepare a PO path and target Net-30.

Attachments: BrightWave_SOW_v1.pdf (draft), vendor_onboarding_form.xlsx (fillable)

Can you confirm the AP contact and whether we should prepare for PO vs card? Once we have that I’ll share an internal mutual action plan and timeline.

Thanks,
Rishi

Redwood Inference

Thanks Rishi — great demo and appreciate the clear next steps. A few clarifications from procurement/finance: 

- AP policy: For BrightWave, anything above $10,000 requires a formal PO and 30-day terms (Net-30). Cards are acceptable for pilots <$10k or for proof-of-concept spend only. 
- Marketplace: Yes — if the vendor is available via our cloud marketplace (we use CloudMarketX), procurement tends to skip the full vendor vetting and it shortens onboarding by ~2 weeks. We are happy to evaluate that route if Redwood is listed or can be.
- Vendor onboarding: Please send the onboarding packet to our procurement intake mailbox: procure-intake@brightwavehealth.com. For SOC/assurance docs, our security team will need SOC2 + encryption KMS info.

On the pilot ask: we are open to starting with a card-based purchase for the initial 30-day evaluation, provided the total pilot cap is <$7,500. If results look good we will move to a PO for production. 

I'll attach our internal vendor_requirements.pdf (high level) so you can see what our team will check.

Lynn
Director, Procurement
BrightWave Health
